name: The Codest brand
scope: Documents the current visual identity from the website design file. Not a rebrand. Copy and claims are governed by the content guide.

source.file: Figma link: design-system/tokens/tokens.json (source), README.md and visual-identity/guidelines.md

files.README.md: Entry point: what is here and where to start
files.AGENT_GUIDE.md: Rules and checklist for AI agents producing anything visual
files.visual-identity/guidelines.md: Visual Identity Guidelines: logo, colour, type, layout, signature outline, icons, waves, imagery, known issues
files.visual-identity/guidelines-print.html: Print layout of the guidelines; open in a browser and print to PDF when a PDF is needed
files.design-system/README.md: How to build a page; tokens, states, every component and section with its Figma source
files.design-system/examples.html: All components rendered on one page
files.design-system/tokens/tokens.json: Source of truth for every value
files.design-system/tokens/tokens.css: Generated CSS variables, font faces and type classes
files.design-system/components/bundle.js: 70 React 18 components on window.Codest (building blocks, cards, sections, navigation)
files.design-system/components/bundle.css: Base component styles on token variables
files.design-system/assets/logo/the-codest-log: Logo for white and pale backgrounds
Logo for navy and dark photo backgrounds
files.design-system/assets/patterns/wave-lines: Line wave texture (hero, case panels), navy at 8%
files.design-system/components/sections.css: Interaction states, page sections, layout helpers, responsive rules
files.design-system/templates/landing-page.htm: Reference landing page following the Figma Home page, built only from the system
files.design-system/templates/service-page.htm: Reference service/campaign page following the Figma PHP service page
files.design-system/assets/patterns/wave-banne: White wave lines for navy banner boxes
files.design-system/assets/patterns/wave-case-: Wave texture for case study panels
files.design-system/assets/graphics/areas-info: Areas-of-expertise graphic: technology circles on the brand gradient
files.design-system/assets/graphics/world-map@: World map with project countries in pink
files.creatives/README.md: How to make images: formats, setup, render commands, rules in short
files.creatives/templates.json: Machine-readable list of creative formats: size, fields, line limits, use
files.creatives/render.js: Fills a creative template from JSON and exports a PNG; warns on long copy (Node + Playwright)
files.creatives/creatives.css: Shared creative styles built on design-system tokens
files.creatives/fill.js: Fills a template from JSON or URL parameters
files.creatives/examples/examples.json: Batch file that renders every example; copy its format for batches
files.case-studies/README.md: Case studies: shared rules, outcomes, and the two workflows (convert, create)
files.case-studies/build.js: Checks content.json against the rules and builds case-study.md, page.html and report.md
files.case-studies/rules/01-format.md: The 10 sections, order, word counts, page layout
files.case-studies/rules/02-titles.md: Title shape (company, technology, outcome), length, what to cut
files.case-studies/rules/03-writing-register.m: Formal professional register, with flagged examples
files.case-studies/rules/04-statistics.md: Where statistics go; capability bullets when there are none
files.case-studies/rules/05-hard-rules.md: Rules never broken: no invented facts, blocked clients, verbatim quotes
files.case-studies/templates/content.schema.js: Shape of a case study content.json
files.case-studies/templates/case-study-page.h: Case study page template built from design system components
files.case-studies/examples/estimote/: Approved reference conversion: content.json, case-study.md, page.html, report.md
files.case-studies/convert/README.md: Workflow 1: convert an old thecodest.co case study
files.case-studies/convert/CODY_TASK.md: Prompt for Cody to convert every case study in convert/inventory.json
files.case-studies/convert/mapping.md: Old thecodest.co sections mapped to the new format
files.case-studies/convert/inventory.json: Every live thecodest.co case study with URL and conversion status
files.case-studies/create/README.md: Workflow 2: create a new case study from Delivery's input
files.case-studies/create/delivery-intake.md: The form Delivery fills in about the project and client
files.case-studies/create/rules.md: Rules for new case studies: intake as source, field-to-section map, consent, gaps and questions
files.case-studies/create/example-intake.md: A completed intake form (Estimote facts) and what Cody does with it
files.case-studies/create/CODY_TASK.md: Prompt for Cody to create a case study from a completed intake form
files.archive/README.md: Files kept for later, not needed to build anything; not moved into Cody's repository
files.archive/creatives-examples/: 18 rendered creative examples (archived; render.js recreates them)

knownIssues: primary-pink on white is 4.17:1, fails WCAG AA for normal text (pink-hover passes at 5.6:1)
MUFG logo in the Home client strip is blocked
Mockup copy, stats and Clutch rating are not approved content
Iosevka Extended not bundled (standard width used)

reference.note: Archived: not needed to build pages; kept in the source repository only

templates.name: social-square
templates.title: Social post, square
templates.use: LinkedIn, Instagram and Meta feed posts. Statements, announcements, hiring, content promotion.

templates.name: social-portrait
templates.title: Social post, portrait 4:5
templates.use: LinkedIn and Instagram feed posts where a photo or more text is needed. Takes the most feed space.

templates.name: story
templates.title: Story, 9:16
templates.use: Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn stories, Reels covers. Keep everything inside the safe area: the top 250px and bottom 340px are covered by the app.

templates.name: link-image
templates.title: Link image / Open Graph
templates.use: Shared links on LinkedIn, X, Slack and messengers; Open Graph image for web pages; LinkedIn sponsored single-image ads.

templates.name: article-cover
templates.title: Article and case study cover
templates.use: Blog article and case study header images, and their social share image.

templates.name: event-promo
templates.title: Webinar and meetup promo
templates.use: Webinar, meetup and event announcements on social. Pair with link-image for the registration link.

templates.name: quote-card
templates.title: Quote card
templates.use: Client or employee quotes on social. Only cleared quotes with approved attribution. Pink tone adds the gradient bar used on pull quotes.

templates.name: linkedin-banner
templates.title: LinkedIn page banner
templates.use: LinkedIn company page and employee profile background. The page logo or profile photo covers the bottom-left, so content sits on the right. No wordmark: the page already shows it.

templates.name: email-header
templates.title: Email header
templates.use: Newsletter and campaign email header. Exported at 1200x400, displayed at 600x200 in the email.

templates.name: ad-300x250
templates.title: Display ad, medium rectangle
templates.use: Google Display and programmatic medium rectangle.

templates.name: ad-300x600
templates.title: Display ad, half page
templates.use: Google Display and programmatic half page.

creatives.status: Layout rules proposed, pending brand-owner sign-off (guidelines section 12)
